# air epoch seconds with wfb_tx injection drops (fec span); each 1 s sample at air time t marks int(t-1) and int(t). Corrected 2026-09-29 ~04:50: uptime -> epoch base 1790633249.97 (was 1790642805 - 9555.60 = .40). Each air date +%s sample truncates, so each base is a lower bound; the three samples of this boot (.40 / .73 / .22 in the air logs) bound it to [.73, 1.22], and every base in that range gives this same file.
